ideas.pitch: A localized IoT relay protection circuit that detects phase imbalances and micro-surges, instantly triggering hardware-level cutoff and transmitting telemetry via ESP32 to a central dashboard.
ideas.title: Smart Microgrid Relay Protection Node
ideas.track: Track 1: Smart Campus & Energy Management (IoT, Microgrids, Relay Protection)
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Track 1 (Smart Campus & Energy Management) and leverages the winning formula of combining a physical custom circuit (similar to the washing machine timer circuit) with real-time IoT dashboards.

ideas.pitch: A wearable vest equipped with ultrasonic sensors and directional haptic vibration motors powered by an Arduino to map obstacles and alert the user without audio interference.
ideas.title: Haptic Assistive Navigational Vest for the Visually Impaired
ideas.track: Track 2: MedTech & Assistive Wearables (Embedded Sensors, Haptic Feedback)
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits perfectly into Track 2 (MedTech & Assistive Wearables), offering a tangible hardware demo with immediate social impact and utilizing physical embedded sensors.

ideas.pitch: A custom-chassis differential drive rover featuring IR array line-following combined with an ESP32-CAM module for real-time obstacle avoidance and remote monitoring.
ideas.title: Autonomous Indoor Line-Following Supply Rover
ideas.track: Track 3: Robotics & Autonomous Systems (Rovers, Motor Drivers, Microcontrollers)
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses Track 3 (Robotics & Autonomous Systems) by bringing a fully functional physical robot that performs a live, demonstrable autonomous routine.

ideas.pitch: An industrial automation prototype using a TCS3200 color sensor and IR counters to sort produce by ripeness on a miniature conveyor belt driven by a stepper motor.
ideas.title: Edge-Powered Automated Sorting Agritech Conveyor
ideas.track: Track 4: Open Innovation (AgriTech, Industrial Automation, Environmental Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Meets the criteria for Track 4 (Open Innovation - AgriTech & Industrial Automation) with a working miniature mechanical build that judges can interact with live on campus.

ideas.pitch: A custom Verilog-based hardware protocol analyzer implemented on an FPGA board to decode asynchronous serial communications in real-time without an external oscilloscope.
ideas.title: FPGA-Accelerated UART Protocol Analyzer
ideas.track: Track 4: Open Innovation (AgriTech, Industrial Automation, Environmental Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard digital design and hardware execution, appealing strongly to an ECE-organized department hackathon looking for rigorous circuit-level engineering.
